preconditions.description: The number of days m is between 1 and 50 inclusive.
The number of stores n is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n-1 for s_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: For each day, the number of integers Dora bought s_i is between 1 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, line.split()[1:]))) == s_i for s_i, line in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]], stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: For each day, the indices of the stores where Dora bought an integer are distinct and s_i in number.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each day, the indices of the stores where Dora bought an integer are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'possible' if all(lcm_dora > lcm_swiper for lcm_dora, lcm_swiper in zip([lcm(a_i for i in dora_stores) for dora_stores in dora_days], [lcm(a_i for i in swiper_stores) for swiper_stores in swiper_days])) else return_value == 'impossible'
postconditions.description: The output is 'possible' if there exist positive integers a_i such that for each day the least common multiple of the integers bought by Dora is strictly greater than the least common multiple of the integers bought by Swiper on that day; otherwise, the output is 'impossible'.
